title: Playboy Magazine June 1987 Donna Edmondson Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a complete June 1987 issue of Playboy Magazine featuring Donna Edmondson on the cover and centerfold. This vintage magazine, originating from the United States, is in English and includes illustrations. The magazine focuses on various topics such as women, art & photography, men's lifestyle, and features articles on photography, art, television, and modeling. Perfect for collectors of vintage magazines or those interested in classic American culture and entertainment.
